title: SS28 Women's Trim Market Strategy
summary: Trim strategy for SS28 womenswear: durable, verifiable and easy to change late.
research_period: SS28 previews published November 2025 to November 2026; SS27 runway record

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. SS28 fabric fairs open with Première Vision Paris on 26-28 January 2027, and the shows run from June to October 2027. This report projects from the first SS28 forecaster and fair previews, the SS27 runways and long-term market and regulatory drivers. Forecut will update it after the fairs and again after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Fashion is expected to remain in low single-digit growth in 2027; resale is expected to grow two to three times faster than first-hand fashion<sup>[1]</sup>
- C2 Fashion Studio calls SS28 "Structured Clarity": consumers "are no longer asking for more. They're asking for better"<sup>[2]</sup>

sections.heading: Build, test, sell through
sections.body:
| Action | Trims |
|---|---|
| Build | Natural buttons (corozo, shell), tonal piping |
| Test | Hand-finished embroidery, technical toggles |
| Sell through | Heavy hardware in summer ranges |

design_implications: - Document trim materials for any environmental claim.
commercial_implications: - Late-added trims (embroidery, piping) let you react to sales.
